description: Measures finite singles counts and rates for resolved quantum links and returns their acquisition provenance. An explicit latchGuard policy is applied to every acquired window; required includes the network-resolved detector-health devices in the declared resource union.

targetLinkIds.description: Unique quantum-link identifiers whose TimeTagger sink channels are measured as singles.

items.description: One target quantum-link identifier resolved from network.json.

measurementDurationSec.description: Finite integration duration for the shared singles observation window, in seconds.

clear.description: Whether the selected stable count-rate measurements are cleared before acquisition.

latchGuard.description: Explicit finite-window latch policy propagated to background and tomography acquisitions. required rejects invalid windows and retries only after detector recovery; disabled deliberately acquires without latch protection.

mode.description: Whether per-window detector-latch validation is disabled or required.

maxWindowRetries.description: Maximum immediate retries of an invalid window after a recovered latch.

resourceDeviceIds.description: Exact acquisition union: TimeTagger plus every network-resolved health guard when required. The acquisition child acquires or inherits these resources.

items.description: One device needed by this acquisition or scan.

link.characterization.observation.single.description: Singles counts and available rates by target link, with resolved TimeTagger channels and acquisition provenance.
